verified_against.method: Code reading of the RetrieveWorkspaceEvidence and RetrievalClient diffs c0006be..84f22f8 and the provider-free report.

finding_status: amendment-1 material_finding RESOLVED. Ambiguous, no_match, empty and consumer-rejected discovery, and typed timeout/connection/service-unavailable failures of the optional review, now execute the original unbound plan, with temporal_guard {status: not_run, reason: discovery_unresolved|discovery_unavailable, fallback: original_unbound}. Auth, integrity, quota/budget, deadline and unknown failures stay fail-closed.
residual_noted: A reviewer response classified invalid_output (malformed model output from the optional review) remains fail-closed (retrieval failed), although pre-C2 these needs made no review call. This is a small availability regression, not a correctness risk. Not blocking; record any occurrence live.
route_classification: Unchanged from amendment 1, except that unresolved or unavailable discovery for G1/G2/G3/R16 now yields the existing-route answer with the guard recorded as not run. Such an outcome is an existing-route result, NOT C2 evidence, whatever the answer.
scoring_rule_added: C2 evidence requires all of: discovery ran; one family was resolved; temporal targets were computed for that family; and the validated temporal use is recorded. Planner-bound items count as C1. Fallback items count as existing-route.
deployment_note: The AI producer (X-Comparison-Review-Failure header) and the API consumer must deploy together; an older AI fails closed on reviewer 503.
